title: Growth Curve Analysis of Bacteria with Bacteriophage
author: Sebastiaan Kuiper
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.77jhrkn
materials: Media and bacteriophage stock solutions : 1L Luria-Bertani (LB) media (with antibiotics) Desired Bacteriophage stock solution in LB media (with known Plaque Forming Units (PFU) ml -1 )

steps.title: Preheat plate reader
steps.instruction: Set the plate reader temperature to 37 °C and allow it to pre‑heat before proceeding.

steps.title: Configure plate reader kinetics
steps.instruction: Program the reader for a 15 h runtime with 4 min intervals; set shaking to medium for 30 s each cycle; select absorbance endpoint mode for the full plate at 600 nm; use normal read speed and a 100 ms delay.

steps.title: Prepare overnight bacterial cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate the desired bacterial strains in appropriate media containing the required antibiotics and grow overnight.

steps.title: Dilute cultures to OD600 0.02
steps.instruction: Measure the OD600 of each overnight culture and dilute with fresh media until the OD600 reaches 0.02.

steps.title: Load diluted cultures into plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 180 µL of each diluted culture into wells of a 96‑well flat‑bottom, tissue‑culture‑treated, black‑wall with clear‑bottom plate (Fisher Scientific Catalog #3904). Include a series of LB‑only wells (no bacteria) as zero‑point controls for OD600.

steps.title: Start growth monitoring
steps.instruction: Start the plate reader using the kinetic program defined in step 2 and monitor the cultures until the OD600 reaches 0.11.

steps.title: Prepare bacteriophage dilutions
steps.instruction: Make phage PFU dilutions (with the same antibiotics as the bacterial cultures) for the following MOI series:

steps.title: Add phage at OD600 0.11
steps.instruction: When the plate reader indicates an OD600 of 0.11, pause the run and add 20 µL of the appropriate phage dilution to each sample well (final volume = 200 µL). Also add 20 µL of LB (with antibiotics) to the LB‑only control wells (no phage).

steps.title: Resume growth measurement
steps.instruction: Restart the plate reader and continue recording absorbance for an additional 15 hours to follow the growth of all samples.
